notes: Magento 2 storefront (coxandcox.co.uk), plain direct HTTPS fetch, no blocking, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Checked homepage nav, sitemap.xml (media/sitemap-1-1.xml + sitemap-1-2.xml), and category pages. Found 3 pet-related URLs site-wide: (1) /home-furnishings/accessories/pet/ - genuine leaf category, breadcrumb Home Furnishings NEW > Accessories NEW > Pet NEW, toolbar-amount '1 Product', single unique data-product-id=20472126 = 'Round Rattan Pet House - Small' (a pet house, Tier 1 Housing & containment) - kept. (2) /outdoor/outdoor-accessories/pet-beds/ - genuine category (own canonical URL, breadcrumb Outdoor > Outdoor Accessories > Pet Beds, page title 'Outdoor Pet Beds for Dogs') but page body contains Magento empty-category message "We can't find products matching the selection." and zero data-product-id tiles - 0 products, dropped per zero-product rule. (3) /gifts/for-pets/ - h1 'Gifts for Pet Lovers', confirmed to be a Page Builder CMS/marketing landing page (no toolbar-amount, no products-grid, no product tiles) not a real PLP - excluded under navigation/marketing-page rule. Also spot-checked individual pet-themed product URLs found in the sitemap (herringbone-wool-dog-bed-blush, blush-herringbone-wool-dog-coat-large, felt-pet-tipi, mandala-pet-bed-soft-grey, indoor-outdoor-hanging-pet-chair-black, etc.) - these are PDPs whose own breadcrumb schema shows no live category assignment (breadcrumb = Home > Product only), i.e. they are not currently reachable via any live PLP, so no additional category rows exist for them. The 'Pet' leaf has no children (no sub-nav found on the page). Prior Home-Decor pass (archive c54) for this same company independently confirmed plain-HTTP access with zero blocking and named 'Pet' among its excluded (out-of-scope-for-that-category) nodes, consistent with what was found here.
